observations: Photo 0 shows the front of a black retail box for a Nikon Z 5 camera.
The box is sitting on a white plastic stool with circular cutouts.
The actual camera body, lens, or accessories are not visible in the photo.
There is a watermark for 'CDICSON BUSINESS WORLD' and 'POSTED ON JIJI'.

claims.evidence: Only the retail box is shown; the camera itself is not visible.
These are technical specifications for the model shown on the box, but the specific item's existence and condition are unconfirmed.

risks.risk: The box may be empty or contain a different, less valuable item.
risks.proof: Photos of the actual camera body from multiple angles (front, back, top, bottom).

risks.risk: The camera may be non-functional or have internal electronic faults.
risks.proof: A video showing the camera powering on, the LCD screen working, and a photo being taken.

risks.risk: The image sensor may be scratched, burnt, or excessively dirty.
risks.proof: A clear, high-resolution close-up photo of the sensor with the body cap or lens removed.

risks.risk: The shutter may have a very high count, indicating heavy professional use.
risks.proof: A screenshot of the shutter count from a recent RAW file or the internal menu.
risks.if_unproven: as having a high shutter count

proof_requests: Photos of the actual camera body from all sides.
A photo of the camera sensor with the lens/cap removed.
A photo of the camera powered on showing the rear LCD screen.
A photo of the serial number on the bottom of the camera body.
Confirmation of included accessories (battery, charger, strap, lens).
response.reason: The seller has only provided a photo of the retail box. Without seeing the actual camera and verifying its condition, it is impossible to determine if the item is present or functional.
